comment: S92 R7: hard px stops on rounded boxes (the port's 7-stop button body, hard and transparent px stops) and gradient layers of a rounded box that are not one tile over it (a centred tile, a strip repeated along x, a grid, a tile in a corner), drawn as gradient primitives (no mask layer). Tolerance: the curves' edge pixels, which the engine covers analytically from the rounded rectangle's distance over a one-pixel ramp and Skia by the covered area: scattered single pixels and short runs differ by up to about 40 levels (no shape difference; the gradients' colours match). Measured 0.344 % on glcore and Vulkan (the mask layers of the mesh path before S92: 0.329 %); the limit is that plus about 10 %, the cluster limit stays at the default (16 px).
